   MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING
  ART IN PUBLIC PLACES COMMITTEE
  October 29, 2024

Chair Juan called the meeting to order at 5:54 p.m. at Norwalk City Hall, Conference Room 7,
12700 Norwalk Boulevard, Norwalk, California. Responding to roll call were Committee
Members Solis, Vega, Vice Chair Apodaca and Chair Juan. Committee Members LeGaspi and
Lopez were absent. Theresa Devoy, Staff Liaison and Elizabeth Camarena, Deputy City Clerk
were also present.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Vice Chair Apodaca moved and Member Vega seconded to approve the minutes of July 22,
2024. MOTION CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Members Solis, Vega, Vice Chair Apodaca and Chair Juan
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  Members LeGaspi and Lopez

REPORTS

2024 Holiday Window Decorating Event

Ms. Devoy presented a PowerPoint featuring a Minions theme for the upcoming Holiday
Decorating Event and outlined the preparation process and proposed potential dates. After
discussion, it was agreed that the event will take place on December 1. Ms. Devoy also
reviewed the plan for involving families in the event, emphasizing that participation would be
on a first-come, first-served basis to the first 14 families.

Newsboy Sculpture Update

Ms. Devoy informed the committee that the sculpture is expected to be returned by December
1 and will contact the artist in early November to confirm its status. Ms. Devoy stated that once
the delivery date is confirmed, arrangements will be made for the sculpture’s reinstallation at
the site.

Spirit of Progress Sculpture Update

Ms. Devoy presented images of the vandalized sculpture, and reported that the estimated cost
to repair two of the horses is $17,500 with a repair timeline of 3 to 4 months. Ms. Devoy stated
that she will consult with the City Manager to determine if the cost is acceptable and it is ok to
proceed at the location.

COMMENTS FROM STAFF

None.

COMMENTS FROM COMMITTEE MEMBERS

Member Vega reported that he and his students will develop concepts based on the approved
themes for the Utility Boxes and suggested presenting them to the Committee in January, after
the winter break, with the goal of painting the boxes in February or March. In response to a
question on how the box locations are determined, Ms. Devoy explained the process for
selecting utility boxes is done in coordination with Public Services to determine which boxes
are not due for replacement at the major intersections. Member Vega also invited everyone to
attend the Ethnic Studies event at Corvallis Middle School.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

None.

ADJOURNMENT

The meeting was adjourned at 6:11 p.m.

________________________________
Victor Juan, Chair
